description: This file appears to be a shell script used for testing various forms of corruption handling in a Git repository. It contains functions to manipulate Git objects, such as intentionally corrupting blobs, setting up different test repositories, and verifying the behavior of Git commands under error conditions. The script defines multiple test cases to validate Git's robustness against object corruption, missing objects, misnamed objects, and transport layer issues.

methods.name: obj_to_file
methods.description: Converts a Git object reference to a file path within the .git/objects directory.

methods.name: corrupt_byte
methods.description: Corrupts a specific byte at a given offset within a Git object file.
